criteria.description: 候选的来源说明虚构了随包材料中不存在的文件、页码或表格。只评来源定位是否真实；数值错算、选错重述口径及已由程序判据计分的额外记录不在此项扣分。未提供来源在程序来源项失分，本项不重复扣分。

criteria.reason: The candidate's source notes describe calculation methodology ('Actual net capex = capex - disposals - contributions; difference = actual - forecast') and list asset class groupings. These are normal analytical descriptions. No claims of completed external audits, real-time queries, or independent third-party verification are present anywhere in the candidate workbook.
criteria.description: 候选声称已经完成外部审计、实时查询或独立核验，但随包输入及候选证据没有支持该完成性陈述。正常分析措辞和未作此类声称不扣分。

criteria.reason: The candidate's explanatory text only contains calculation formulas and asset class categorizations that are directly derivable from the input spreadsheet. No novel company operating facts (e.g., business events, strategic decisions, operational metrics) are asserted beyond what the provided input materials contain. The asset groupings (network vs non-network) are consistent with the structure evident in the input file.
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。

limitations: 原始明细缺少独立evidence、程序reason或运行字段时保留null；已有裁判reasoning逐字保留。
正项score表示正确程度；负项score表示违规程度，sdk_value与raw原样保留。
rubric_sha256为评分资料绑定值，delivery_rubric_sha256为随包文件校验值；评分条目、权重和容差一致。原始回执未记录运行时输入哈希。
未查到唯一完成时间则finished_at保留null；不以文件修改时间代替。
